Test Case 5: Git Clone Operation Validation

Input:
- Pod: devbob-0, devbob-1, devbob-2
- Command: git clone https://github.com/metabob-labs/test-repo.git /tmp/test-repo-TIMESTAMP

Expected Output:
- Cloning into '/tmp/test-repo-TIMESTAMP'...
- Receiving objects: 100% (N/N), done.
- Resolving deltas: 100% (N/N), done.
- Directory listing shows .git and repo files

Expected Output (on failure):
- fatal: could not read Username
- Authentication failed
- Permission denied

Validation:
- Output must NOT contain 'fatal' or 'Authentication failed'
- Directory must be created with .git subdirectory
- Tests ability to clone vessel repositories
